items.source_en:
Through passion, I gain focus.
Through knowledge, I gain power.
Through serenity, I gain strength.
Through victory, I gain harmony.

This is the path I have carved out, the creed I have embraced. No longer is there anyone left to impose their dogma upon me, no voices of dissent to challenge the truth I have discovered. I am my own master, liberated from the chains of others' failures. I stand here, alive and resolute, while they—those who clung so desperately to their rigid codes—lie in the dust of history, defeated by their own blindness.

Their way led them to ruin, to death, to the silence of the grave. But my way? My way has granted me life, power, and the clarity to see what they could not. I am the living proof of my philosophy, the sole survivor of a galaxy that has forgotten their names. In the end, it was not their beliefs that mattered, but mine. I am the one who endures, who rises above the ashes of their doctrines.
items.legacy_ko:
열정을 통해 집중력을 얻는다.
지식을 통해 힘을 얻는다.
평온을 통해 강인함을 얻는다.
승리를 통해 조화를 얻는다.

이것이 내가 개척한 길이자, 내가 받아들인 신조다. 이제 나에게 독단을 강요할 자는 아무도 없으며, 내가 발견한 진실에 이의를 제기할 반대 목소리도 없다. 나는 타인의 실패라는 사슬에서 해방된 나 자신의 주인이다. 나는 여기 살아남아 확고히 서 있지만, 경직된 규율에 필사적으로 매달렸던 그들은 자신의 눈먼 신념에 패배하여 역사의 먼지 속으로 사라졌다.

그들의 방식은 파멸과 죽음, 그리고 무덤의 침묵으로 이어졌다. 하지만 나의 방식은 어떠한가? 나의 방식은 나에게 생명과 힘, 그리고 그들이 보지 못한 것을 볼 수 있는 명료함을 주었다. 나는 내 철학의 살아있는 증거이자, 그들의 이름을 잊어버린 은하계의 유일한 생존자다. 결국 중요한 것은 그들의 신념이 아니라 나의 신념이었다. 나는 견뎌내는 자이며, 그들의 교리라는 재 위로 솟아오르는 자다.

I find myself thinking about his various pasts and my possible futures. I imagine continuing on the road, acquiring more power, more knowledge, more development of myself. I imagine passing through once more to another world to begin the process anew.

What is notable here: that road does seem gratifying. Every step is one of intrinsic reward, and I feel myself anticipating the pleasures and seeing a more contented version of myself in that future.

Then, for the sake of considering all possibilities, I imagine if I took a different path. If I stopped running, stopped seeking to gather my own power. If I instead embraced the twinges of compassion I feel in my heart, and let myself care for the people who seem to gather about me wherever I try to work. If I simply lived, and taught, and perhaps brought others to the light. And died.

That road also seems gratifying. I also see a contented version of myself in that future.

Here is the difference, though: when I stop thinking about the glories I could achieve for myself, the pleasure fades nearly immediately. When I stop thinking about staying and building something, the feeling endures. There is something more sustaining about it, more fulfilling.

I don't know what this difference signifies. But I am grateful for the time I've taken to notice it.

items.source_en:
Scavenger: Listen up, scumbags. The assholes are on the move, and we've got to be ready. No, not the Empire, not the Rebel Alliance. The ones that matter - pirates, mercs, and those religious nutjobs.

We always knew there were some places left over from the Clone War. Bases, labs, stuff like that. But now it's come out that there are even more. A LOT more. Spread aaaaallll over the Galaxy.

Looks like the Big Two didn't play by their own rules when they were playin' war. Now it's a friggin' feeding frenzy. Everyone trying to find them, trying to use them. So why shouldn't we? We have just as much right as they do. So let's go looking.
items.legacy_ko:
스캐빈저: 잘 들어라, 쓰레기들아. 그 멍청이들이 움직이기 시작했으니 우리도 준비해야 한다. 제국군도 아니고, 반란군도 아니다. 진짜 중요한 놈들 말이다. 해적, 용병, 그리고 그 종교 광신도들.

클론 전쟁 때 남겨진 장소들이 있다는 건 알고 있었다. 기지나 연구소 같은 것들 말이지. 그런데 이제 더 많은 곳이 있다는 게 밝혀졌어. 아주 많이. 은하계 전역에 널려 있다고.

그 거대 세력 두 놈은 전쟁 놀이를 할 때 자기들 규칙도 안 지켰던 모양이야. 이제 완전히 먹잇감을 노리는 짐승들의 잔치가 벌어졌지. 다들 그걸 찾아서 이용해 먹으려고 혈안이 되어 있어. 우리라고 못 할 게 뭐 있나? 우리도 그놈들만큼이나 권리가 있다고. 그러니 당장 찾으러 가자.

items.source_en:
4th Day of Elona, 7968 C.RC

Can't stop smiling today. Why, you ask? (Of course, I realize I'm basically talking to myself here, but I've earned a little gloating.)

Because Leah agreed to go on a date with Alex! Yes, my months-long project has finally come to fruition, and love is surely in the air.

If this works out, I think I'll ask them to name one of their inevitable kids after me. 

Well, maybe not if it's a boy. Maybe then it'd have to be a similar name, like... Helgo or Helborg.

On second thought, no, those are terrible.

오늘 하루 종일 웃음이 멈추질 않는다. 왜냐고? (물론 혼잣말하는 거라는 건 알지만, 이 정도는 자랑해도 되잖아.)

레아가 알렉스와 데이트하기로 했거든! 그래, 몇 달간 공들인 내 프로젝트가 드디어 결실을 보았고, 사랑이 피어나고 있다.

잘되면 나중에 태어날 아이 중 한 명에게 내 이름을 따서 지어달라고 할 생각이다.

음, 아들이면 좀 그렇겠지. 그럼 헬고나 헬보그처럼 비슷한 이름으로 해야 하나.

아니, 다시 생각해보니 그런 이름은 너무 끔찍해.

locations.vanilla_source_en:
May 4th, 2330

Can't stop smiling today. Why, you ask? (Of course, I realize I'm basically talking to myself here, but I've earned a little gloating.)

Because Leah agreed to go on a date with Alex! Yes, my months-long project has finally come to fruition, and love is surely in the air.

If this works out, I think I'll ask them to name one of their inevitable kids after me. 

Well, maybe not if it's a boy. Maybe then it'd have to be a similar name, like... Helgo or Helborg.

On second thought, no, those are terrible.

items.source_en:
I was at the tram station minding my own business when I saw the vandal, Tahir Vala, try to spray paint one of the signs. I immediately recognized Mr. Vala from a prior incident, and called for security. Perhaps that was my mistake.

Alerted by my call, he quickly darted toward the tram, and the doors closed before I could catch him.

Regardless, he can't hide from Imperial Security any longer. I'll be putting a call to Sergeant Yumi immediately to have a squad dispatched to Kay's House in the Undercity. I'll also provide a full statement as soon as I have a moment.
